articles.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
articles.snippet: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

articles.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
articles.snippet: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

articles.title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
articles.snippet: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.
